name: Store Asset
description: Store an immutable content-addressed asset in your a/ namespace. The ID is the CAD3 hash — storing identical metadata twice returns the same ID (idempotent). Use for documents, definitions, or data needing a stable tamper-proof identity. For named operations callable via grid_run, prefer covia_write to o/<name> — simpler than store-then-pin.

metadata.description: Arbitrary JSON metadata for the asset, as a JSON object (or a string containing one, parsed on receipt). The asset ID is computed from the stored metadata. Include a 'name' field for discoverability and a 'type' field for filtering (e.g. 'agent-definition', 'invoice', 'document'). When content bytes are supplied, metadata.content must be an object (or absent) — the venue validates or injects content.sha256 into it; any other shape is an error.

content.description: Optional content payload as a hex-encoded Blob (must start with 0x). Retrieved separately via asset:content. Mutually exclusive with contentText.

contentText.description: Optional content payload as plain text (auto-encoded to UTF-8 Blob). Convenience alternative to content for text documents. Mutually exclusive with content.

ref.description: Fully-qualified DID/a reference for the stored asset
